patterns: APPSC asks year of launch (NRHM 2005) and AP-specific ABDM firsts (AP first state to link 1 crore health records).

App adds many 2026 current-affairs figures (ABHA count, Sanjeevani, PM-ABHIM in AP) and multi-statement items; PYQs are direct.
